scope: Exact Moonwash Coast terrain, harbor near and regional tiers, dry-stone shoulder returns, eight thickets and gated transition for the opt-in Mara overworld playtest. Restricted to reviewed native high gate and regional compositions. Not normal launch, optional XP, other campaigns, arbitrary camera or target hardware.
author: Torn Asunder Moonwash environment, landmark, batching and title-integration authors
reviewer: Independent Moonwash actual-title art gate reviewer

evidence.godot_context: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility, 1280 by 720 exact high-gate and regional cameras and Marches lighting/fog. Approved exact shoulder art and coast thickets in title, followed by a normal source-import equality check; see evidence/moonwash-overworld-development.jpg.
evidence.close_up: Two original tapered dry-stone returns fade into the headland; distinct existing slate-roof pilot tower, high gate, stone stairs, open pier and water gap by the vessel remain in their original positions.
evidence.motion: Actual title 44/44, Water Request legacy paths 35/35. Exclusive narrow/wide Harbor tier, eight grounded thickets, approach rays, separate Harbor briefing and opt-in save/profile behavior. Mission result hook used to test the transition, not counted as a played Grain clear.
evidence.reproduction: After Godot import, run tests/mara_sector_overworld_authored.gd and tests/mara_water_request_authored.gd. Use the existing opt-in playtest and switch to Moonwash only after the actual Grain clear and Water Request.
evidence.measurements: 334/334 native approach samples; 485.07614 m route, max source deviation 0.084 mm. Clean normal import produced no pixel changes in 921,600 samples in each of two matched poses. Strict Harbor batching alone: 409→220 / 291 visible submissions in matched angles; no GPU timing. Shoulder returns: 4,346 triangles and two surfaces.

shape_and_craft.finding: Original high gate, pier, stepped receiving quay and vessel read at close scale; both new limestone returns blend dry ground into the headland without intersecting usable routes or the wet edge.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Fixed scene camera/light and native author A/B show compatible stone, timber, coastal soil, vegetation and water. The canonical imports match the registered render in both audited poses.

readability_in_play.finding: Distinct shore silhouette and visible high-gate label, quiet thicket composition and existing return sign preserve player-facing route and briefing cues.

motion_and_effects.finding: Real title follows the measured coast path. Transition is a prior-save-preserving zone handoff. All 334 checked ground samples match the intended route, without adding collision to the scenery returns.

integration_and_cost.finding: Actual combined title and repeated legacy save paths passed with canonical resources; no raw runtime art loading. Near independently batched scope reduces submissions as shown in evidence, without a device performance claim.
